author_or_institution: Fabrizio Dell’Acqua et al. / Organization Science
title: The Cybernetic Teammate: A Field Experiment on Generative AI and Teamwork
book_use: Evidence from 791 Procter & Gamble professionals that individuals using AI matched teams without AI on real product-innovation tasks, AI helped bridge R&D and commercial silos, and human judgment retained value in evaluating and selecting among generated ideas.
